headline: Sensex, Nifty End Marginally Lower in Diwali Muhurat Trading Session, Snapping Seven-Day Winning Streak

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Sensex and Nifty ended marginally lower during the special Muhurat Trading session for Diwali.
The small decline broke a seven-day winning streak for Indian benchmark indices.
Bharti Airtel and Infosys emerged as top losers during the session, pressing market sentiment.
Indian equities had posted their best weekly performance in six years ahead of Diwali, bucking global tech weakness.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE conducted the special Muhurat Trading session to mark Diwali and the start of Samvat 2083.
Nifty closed below the 25,000 level during the Muhurat Trading session.
Indian markets ended in the red on a Diwali trading day for the first time in eight years.
Kalpataru expressed confidence in reaching its Rs 6,500-crore FY27 pre-sales target driven by strong housing demand.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed marginally lower during the Diwali Muhurat Trading session, ending a seven-day rally. Bharti Airtel and Infosys were among the key laggards as Nifty closed below the 25,000 level. Despite the session's slight dip, Indian stocks logged their best weekly gain in six years leading into Samvat 2083.
